text:
maria-security: Quick preflight question — were planning to enable structured request logging for /v1/stream to help debug a dropdown of customer issues. Plan is to capture headers + minimal body (first N tokens) for 48h. Do we mask X-User-Id in headers or is strong hashing acceptable?

kai-eng: Strong hashing (sha256) has been our default in a few places, but remember hashing alone is reversible if attacker has original values. HMAC with a per-env key is safer.

sam-sre: +1 for HMAC. Also: is retention 48h temporary for debugging only? we need an approval path to keep it.

maria-security: Yes 48h is temporary. Well rotate the HMAC key monthly via KMS. Tentative config snippet: 
```
headers: [
  {name: "X-User-Id", transform: "hmac:kms://projects/redwood/keys/logging-key"},
  {name: "X-Session-Id", transform: "remove"}
]
body_capture: { mode: "prefix", tokens: 32 }
retention: "48h"
```

jordan-privacy: That looks good. One ask: for embeddings/LLM prompts we should also redact any email-like strings in the captured prefix. Could add an extra scrub step with regex.

kai-eng: We can plug a scrubber post-transform: `scrubbers.email = true` — cheap and fast. Any objections to adding it to the pipeline?

maria-security: No objections. Also_cc @audit-bot for audit log record.

audit-bot: Recorded request: temporary structured logging on /v1/stream; retention=48h; transforms=[hmac(X-User-Id), remove(X-Session-Id), scrub(email)]; key_ref=kms://projects/redwood/keys/logging-key. Approval pending from security/product.

sam-sre: For rollout, suggest feature-flag gated: enable for 10% traffic, monitor error/latency impact, then bump. Also ensure S3 buckets for logs are access-restricted and tagged.

jordan-privacy: Add a note: logs will be flagged as PII and access require `pii-llm-logs` allowlist.

maria-security: Thanks. I'll update the runbook and add the feature flag + scrub config. Filing approval request in the compliance tracker now.

kai-eng: If anyone wants to review the exact scrub regex Ill paste it here later.

maria-security: Awesome — will ping when approval is in. :thumbsup:
